source_refs.note: Book p. 79: 5.1.1 Proper Rational Fraction (definition and three examples). The degree table, Teaching note, Exam tip, Key points and Common mistakes are ours.

blocks.text: Pichle page par hum ne dekha ke rational fraction ki do qismein hain. Is sabaq mein pehli qism: proper rational fraction. Yeh pehchaan bohat zaroori hai, kyun ke partial fractions ka tareeqa seedha sirf proper fraction par chalta hai. Is liye har sawal mein sab se pehla kaam yahi check hota hai.
Ek rational function \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) Proper Rational Fraction kehlata hai agar numerator wale polynomial \(P(x)\) ki degree denominator wale polynomial \(Q(x)\) ki degree se kam ho.
Misaal ke taur par \(\frac{3}{x+1}\), \(\frac{2x-5}{x^{2}+4}\) aur \(\frac{9x^{2}}{x^{3}-1}\) proper rational fractions, ya mukhtasar mein proper fractions, hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Faisla karne ke liye sirf do numbers dhoondne hain aur unka muqabla karna hai: numerator ki degree aur denominator ki degree (yani \(x\) ki sab se bari power). Coefficients kitne bare hain, is se koi farq nahin parta.
Yeh bilkul arithmetic jaisa hai: \(\frac{3}{4}\) proper hai kyun ke upar wala neeche wale se chhota hai. Yahan "chhota" ka matlab hai degree mein chhota.
Neeche table mein kitab ki teeno misaalon ki jaanch ki gayi hai. Pehli misaal par ghor kijiye: numerator \(3\) sirf ek constant hai, aur non-zero constant ki degree 0 hoti hai, kyun ke \(3 = 3x^{0}\) (aur \(x^{0} = 1\)). Is liye \(0 < 1\), aur fraction proper hai.

blocks.caption: Kitab ki teen proper fractions ki jaanch

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Jab denominator multiplication ki shakal mein diya ho, to uski degree uske factors ki degrees ka jama hoti hai: \((x+1)(x-2)\) ki degree \(1 + 1 = 2\), aur \((x-1)^{2}(x+3)\) ki degree \(2 + 1 = 3\). Kyun? Kyun ke multiply karte waqt sab se bari powers aapas mein multiply hoti hain: \(x \cdot x = x^{2}\). Is liye poora multiply karne ki zaroorat nahin.
Har sawal mein pehle yeh dekhiye: "proper hai ya nahin?" Sirf proper fraction ko seedha partial fractions mein toda jata hai; 5.1.3 ke tareeqe ka step (i) yahi hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
In mein se kaun si fractions proper hain?
1. \(\frac{100}{x^{2}+1}\)
2. \(\frac{x^{2}+1}{x^{2}-1}\)
3. \(\frac{5x+7}{(x-1)(x+2)}\)
Jawab: 1 proper hai (\(0 < 2\); 100 bara number hai lekin uski degree 0 hai). 2 proper nahin (\(2 = 2\), degrees barabar hain; yeh agle page ki improper qism hai). 3 proper hai (\(1 < 1 + 1 = 2\)).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ek aur misaal hamari taraf se (kitab ki nahin): \(\frac{x^{3}+2}{x(x^{2}+1)(x-3)}\).
Numerator ki degree: 3.
Denominator ki degree: \(1 + 2 + 1 = 4\) (har factor ki degree jama ki).
\(3 < 4\), is liye yeh proper fraction hai, aur ise seedha partial fractions mein toda ja sakta hai, koi division nahin chahiye.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) proper hai jab \(P(x)\) ki degree < \(Q(x)\) ki degree.
2. Degree = \(x\) ki sab se bari power; non-zero constant ki degree 0.
3. Product ki degree = factors ki degrees ka jama.
4. Proper fraction ko seedha partial fractions mein torte hain; har sawal mein pehle yahi check karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Powers ki jagah coefficients ka muqabla karna: \(\frac{9x^{2}}{x^{3}-1}\) proper hai halaan ke \(9 > 1\); sirf powers 2 aur 3 ginti mein aati hain.
2. Terms ki ginti ka muqabla karna: \(\frac{2x-5}{x^{2}+4}\) mein upar bhi do terms hain aur neeche bhi do, phir bhi yeh proper hai (\(1 < 2\)).
3. \((x+1)(x-2)\) ki degree 1 samajh lena: do linear factors ka product degree 2 ka hota hai. Bachne ka tareeqa: har factor ki degree likh kar jama karein.
